Footer.note: Development version — schedules and fares are examples.

Home.title: Your destination. Your choice of seat.
Home.intro: Choose your time and station, and see exactly where you will sit before booking.
Home.apiUnavailable: Trips could not be loaded. Please refresh this page shortly.
Home.noCities: No cities are available to search right now.
Home.destinationsText: Journeys between Egyptian cities. Choose a route to see departure times.
Home.step1Text: Search by city or choose your exact departure and arrival stations.
Home.step2Text: See the aisle and front of the bus, then choose your seat.
Home.step3Text: Review your journey, passenger details and payment in your booking.

Search.invalid: Choose different departure and arrival points and a valid date.

Trips.title: Search results
Trips.invalid: Check your cities or stations and travel date.
Trips.emptyHint: Try another date, or search all stations in the city.
Trips.dateNote: All times are in Cairo time.

Detail.error: This trip could not be loaded, or is no longer available.

Seats.title: Choose your seat
Seats.subtitle: This is the inside of your bus. Select an available seat.
Seats.refreshFailed: Seat availability could not be refreshed. Refresh before booking.
Seats.layoutNote: The front is at the top. Seat positions stay the same in both languages.
Seats.chooseFirst: Select an available seat to add it to your journey.
Seats.changed: A selected seat is no longer available. Please check your selection.
Seats.notReserved: Selection alone does not reserve a seat. Seats are held after passenger details are confirmed.
Seats.holdNote: After confirmation, your seats are held for 10 minutes to complete payment. Passengers cannot cancel bookings.
Seats.conflict: A selected seat is no longer available. Choose another seat.
Seats.uncertain: We could not confirm the request result. Check My bookings before trying again to avoid creating an additional reservation.
Seats.numberedOnly: This view shows seat numbers and availability only; physical positions are not defined for this bus.
Seats.facilitiesLayoutNote: The front is at the top. The WC is opposite seats 17–18, followed by the middle door opposite 19–20. Seat positions stay the same in both languages.

Auth.name: Full name
Auth.internationalPhone: Include your country code, for example +20 for Egypt.
Auth.codeSent: Enter the six-digit code sent to
Auth.verified: Your email is verified. You can sign in now.
Auth.checkDetails: Check your name, email, international phone and password (at least 12 characters).
Auth.waitResend: Please wait a minute between code requests.
Auth.resent: A new code was requested. Check your email.
Auth.welcomeText: Choose your seat, follow your booking and review your journey details whenever you need.
Auth.sessionUnavailable: Your session could not be checked right now. Please try again.
Auth.forbiddenTitle: You do not have access to this page
Auth.forbiddenText: You are signed in, but your account role cannot access this page.

Booking.noCancellation: Passengers cannot cancel bookings. If the operator cancels the trip, the full paid amount is refunded.
Booking.paymentNote: You will be sent to the secure payment page. Your booking is confirmed after successful payment.
Booking.expired: The payment deadline has passed. Search again and choose available seats.
Booking.noBookingsText: Start by finding a trip, then choose your preferred seat.
Booking.checkoutUnavailable: Online payment is currently unavailable. Check the recorded payment status above.

PaymentResult.title: Payment result
PaymentResult.note: Check your payment status and view your ticket once your booking is confirmed.
PaymentResult.chooseBooking: Open the booking you just paid for to check its latest status and view your ticket after confirmation.

paid.title: Payment confirmed. Your booking is confirmed.

processing.title: We are checking your payment
processing.note: Do not pay again or create another booking for these seats. This page refreshes automatically while verification is pending.

waiting.title: Payment has not been confirmed
waiting.note: Complete payment within the reservation deadline. If you already paid, refresh the status and wait for server confirmation.

failed.title: Payment was unsuccessful
failed.note: This attempt did not complete successfully. Check the latest status before making another reservation.

expired.title: The reservation expired
expired.note: This reservation can no longer be paid. Search again and choose currently available seats.

review.title: Payment needs review
review.note: Keep your booking reference. Do not repeat payment; no ticket is available until the booking is confirmed.

refundRequired.title: Payment cannot confirm this booking
refundRequired.note: A full refund is due. Keep your booking reference and follow the refund status here.

refunded.title: Full refund confirmed
refunded.note: This booking does not have a valid ticket. The time to reach your account depends on the payment provider and bank.

cancelled.title: The operator cancelled this trip
cancelled.note: The ticket is no longer valid. Any full refund due is shown separately below.

PaymentResult.checkingNote: We are checking your booking payment. The result will appear here automatically once confirmed.
PaymentResult.checkingSafety: Please do not pay again while we check.

Ticket.title: Your ticket
Ticket.timeZone: All dates and times are in Cairo time.
Ticket.qrNote: This code identifies the ticket. It is not, by itself, boarding authorization. Reopen this page to check the current ticket status.
Ticket.qrError: The QR image could not be displayed. Keep your booking reference.
Ticket.unavailableNote: A ticket is available only for a paid, confirmed booking on a trip that has not been cancelled. Open your booking to check its status.

Recovery.introText: Use your account email to set a new password and return to your bookings.
Recovery.requestNote: Enter your account email to request a recovery code.
Recovery.resetNote: Enter the six-digit code. It expires after ten minutes; use the most recent code you requested.
Recovery.requested: If recovery is available for this account, an email with a code will arrive. Check your inbox and spam folder.
Recovery.resendAfter: Request a new code in {seconds} seconds
Recovery.successNote: Sign in with your new password. Previous sessions for this account have been revoked.
Recovery.uncertain: We could not confirm the request result. Try signing in with your new password before requesting another reset.

Account.title: My account
Account.name: Name
Account.sessionHint: Using a shared device? Sign out when you finish. You can also end all your signed-in sessions, including this one.
Account.confirm: This will sign you out everywhere, including this device. You will need to sign in again to view your bookings.
